scope: Streaming read-aloud v2 on the phone tree: eligibility rework (R1/R2/R3 plus alpha/beta/gamma baselines), explicit capability decision tree with page cache, single-task protocol frame split, typing decoupling and legacy-path removal. Same-path post-override after sharedHomeAdmissionFinal on the harmony platform; the upstream web-line PR records its own commit linkage. Round 2 (PR review): a conversation_ack status line reads like reply text ahead of the body through the same task; every resend (edit resend, retry) stops the reply being read; the phone streaming projection holds an unstructured marker only within a bounded code-point window of the source tail so a literal | or unclosed [ no longer stalls the feed, with bounded spoken-cursor realignment when a released marker later closes. Round 3 (PR review): the spoken cursor no longer depends on the status block position (the ack reads ahead of the body under the projected [text..., status] order, in the same frame, and across settled body frames), and a reclassified construct rolls the spoken cursor back to the code-point common prefix and rereads instead of leaving the tail silent and consumed. E2/E2b field round (HAP40, incident 2026-11-02): a streaming row is never absorbed as baseline (scope entry or history-load window), the chat-list refresh leaves the read gate, a hidden host parks speech at the spoken cursor instead of consuming it, one task failure no longer consumes the reply, the client closes an idle task inside the 23 s provider budget, short completed sentences batch to a 20 code-point minimum with a 1.5 s hold, and a tool step flushes the pending tail. Review round (PR #112): a held short span leaves with a retried run or a dropped row (no stale hold rescheduling); a task failure keeps the deltas queued but never sent and continues them through the next task; the Harmony shell forwards EntryAbility.onBackground/onForeground to the page as a garnet:lifecycle event that parks and resumes speech. V2/V3 round: thinking is collapsed by default everywhere (live, settled and history) and opens only through the accessible user disclosure; tapping that disclosure never interrupts read-aloud, whose interruptions remain the bubble tap on the row being read and every new-input submission path. E2/E2c/E2d field round (HAP41, incident 2026-11-02): a streaming reply commits an unambiguous trailing sentence (CJK terminals, Latin !?, a hard line break) in the tick it completes, so the first sentence opens the task on arrival instead of waiting for the second sentence and every later commit keeps the one task inside the provider input gap; a failed task rolls its already-fed text back to the front of the queue and re-reads it through the next task (a bounded duplicate instead of the E2c mid-reply drop), a settle flush that landed in a failing task is therefore recoverable, a premature ended closes its task gracefully instead of aborting an in-flight append into a manufactured failure, and a deliberate AbortError never counts toward the consecutive-failure limit; per-frame observability (input_frame_sent sequence/offset/codepoints, task_failed fed codepoints) lands in the bounded timing export; a same-page re-read of unchanged text replays the captured cache without a new synthesis.
